property_summary: After a deposit of 1 wei from an account with no prior credit, the reference contract allows a subsequent withdrawAll to succeed and reset credit to 0, while the buggy contract's modified modifier causes a revert on the require(true) logic (never executing the body) and thus the balance after withdrawAll differs.
change_summary: Replace 'require(!__lock_modifier0_lock);' with 'require(__lock_modifier0_lock);' to invert the mutex condition.
